column1: # Texts that change every sum of money in another text without naming its
# articles ("all amounts wherever they appear in the Code of Civil Procedure
# are multiplied by fifty"). A citation can only link such a text to the
# changed text as a whole, so no article page showed it. The build links
# each one, as published, to every article in scope that states a sum in
# Lebanese pounds (graph_edge source 'editorial'). Nothing is computed and
# no wording changes: the reader sees the article as published and the text
# Listed only when the change is not in the Centre's wording yet. Columns:
# the changing text's Centre id and article, the changed text's Centre id,
# the first and last article in scope (empty for every article), what it
# changes (sums: any sum; fines: only articles that also name a fine), a note.

column7: Decree 13909/2024: every sum in the Code of Civil Procedure x50, from 19 Sep 2024
Budget Law 324/2024 art. 42: fines in the Traffic Law (Law 243/2012) x10, never under 250,000
